item.title: Funeral held for Florida Trooper who died during training exercise
item.description: NAPLES, Fla. (WFLA) — A funeral for Florida Trooper Michael Diego is being held in Naples on Saturday, Feb. 28. Diego was participating in a "competitive process" at the Florida Highway Patrol training academy when he suffered a medical emergency earlier this month. Despite lifesaving efforts, he later died at Tallahassee Memorial Hospital, FHP said. [...]
